QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Gathering Scattered Memories 2
QuestInfo.0: You agree to gather the scattered memories from the strong Erdas around town. Talk to Chief Legato and hear about the next memories you need to recover.
QuestInfo.1: You agree to get Chief Legato 5 Raging Memories from Raging Erdas.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Chief Legato 5 Raging Memories from Raging Erdas.

0.0: For your next task, I ask you to recover the Raging Memories. Are you ready?

yes.0: The Raging Erdas in the Weathered Land of Rage possess our Raging Memories. 50 Raging Memories once hung upon the Tree of Memory. Please be careful out there.

no.0: You are the only one who can recover our memories from those powerful Erdas.

1.0: You have recovered all of the Raging Memories that once hung upon the Tree of Memory. Please place them back upon the tree.

yes.0: Look at that, all of the Raging Memories are back in their place, thanks to you. But there are still more memories to recover.

item.0: Bring me Raging Memories from the Raging Erdas in the Weathered Land of Rage.
